versions.changelog:
**Expanded agent map coverage for new data sources.**

- Added 54 new Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) data source maps, bringing the total to 55 SSE pages.
- Included 4 international API sources for broader coverage.
- Updated documentation to list all 59 currently indexed maps in structured tables.
- No changes to usage, parameters, or functionality—only a significant expansion of supported URLs.

- Initial release of veriglow-agent-map.
- Query website URLs to look up data functions, internal APIs, browser automation recipes, and agent reliability reports.
- Supports extraction of structured data, discovery of hidden APIs, and browser automation strategies for web pages.
- Includes detailed documentation for each mapped data source, with real-world agent usage reports and automation guides.
- Compatible with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Cursor, and similar AI agents.
